title: Los Angeles weather: Southern California to see warm temperatures before rain arrives end of week - ABC7 Los Angeles
text:
Los Angeles weather: Southern California to see warm Wednesday as rain chances arrive later this week - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Weather 
 SoCal to see warm Wednesday as rain chances arrive later this week 
 Southern California could see rain again by the end of the week, but the region will first see another day of summer-like temperatures. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 7:13AM Share Follow ABC7 on Google Este artículo se ofrece en Español LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- Southern California is expected to see another day of summer-like temperatures before cooler weather and rain chances arrive later this week.
 Warm and dry conditions with sunny skies are expected on Veterans Day, with slight cooling coming on Thursday.
 ABC7 has issued a Weather Change Alert for Friday, when rain is expected to arrive and continue into early next week. Several areas will be in the 60s and 70s.
 An area of low pressure moving into the region will provide the first chance of rain Friday into Saturday, though the system does not appear particularly strong. There could be a break in the wet weather Sunday before another system arrives Monday, bringing a better chance for heavier rain. Rainfall totals of one-half inch to 1 inch are possible.
 Wednesday forecast
 Los Angeles and Orange counties are expected to see a high of 87 degrees and a low of 61 degrees Wednesday. Slight cooling is expected Thursday before rain chances increase Friday.
 The valleys and Inland Empire are expected to reach a high of 88 degrees and a low of 55 degrees Wednesday. A slight chance of showers is expected Friday morning, with a stronger chance of rain developing later in the evening.
 Beach communities can expect sunny conditions Wednesday, with a high of 80 degrees and a low of 62 degrees.
 Mountain areas will see sunny skies on Wednesday, with a high of 62 degrees and a low of 34. Similar weather is expected Thursday before rain chances increase Friday.
 Deserts are expected to reach a high of 77 degrees and a low of 42 on Wednesday. Palm Springs is expected to reach a high of 88 degrees.
